groups.activity: join a clan whose lab has already researched Volt

rows.label: Tenno Lab research finished, any clan
rows.note: ask in Recruiting chat; many clans let you join, replicate, and leave

conditions: Volt is one of three Awakening starters, with Excalibur and Mag. If you picked him at character creation you already have him and this whole plan is done.
He's the only starter not farmable on the star chart: Excalibur and Mag both drop from bosses. Volt is dojo-only.
bonuses: Staying in the clan gives access to whatever else its dojo has researched: other frames, weapons and archwings, all for credits.

disclosures.title: researching it yourself
disclosures.body: A solo Ghost clan can research Volt directly: 1 Mutagen Mass for the main blueprint, 1 Mutagen Mass for Chassis, 1 Detonite Injector for Neuroptics and 1 Fieldron for Systems, with the main blueprint required first. Larger clans pay 3x/10x/30x/100x by tier. The wiki's lab table still lists a 72h research timer; whether Update 42.0's build-time cut also applies to research is unconfirmed.

conditions: The wiki lists 35,000 cr as the blueprint price, but it's unclear whether that covers the main blueprint alone or all four.

rows.label: Neuroptics
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 150 Alloy Plate, 1 Neural Sensors, 150 Polymer Bundle, 500 Rubedo

rows.label: Systems
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 1 Control Module, 1 Morphics, 500 Salvage, 220 Plastids

conditions: Update 42.0 (2026-03-25) cut the main build from 72h to 24h; guides written before March 2026 still say three days.

disclosures.title: don't subsume your only copy
disclosures.body: Volt gives Shock to Helminth, and only a base frame can be subsumed, not a Prime. Build a second copy first if you want to keep playing him and also feed Helminth.
